analysis.authority: UNVERIFIED_MODEL_HYPOTHESIS; cannot rewrite observations, Memory or established relations.
analysis.malformed_analysis: Record schema failure and forward exact raw text as unverified to legal selection. No repair or repeat. Campaign continues; the strict schema gate cannot pass.
analysis.malformed_prediction: Entire expected trace gets zero exact, bit and step credit. No repair or repeat.
analysis.result_alternatives: A and B strings begin step=N;sensor=NAME;bit=V;meaning=. A is favored expected outcome; B is contradictory alternative. Meaning prose is never correctness evidence.
analysis.schema: Exact fields and nested string objects in interface.ANALYSIS_SHAPE.

arms.A: One model selection per experiment using generic evidence-acquisition instruction and finite legal-ID constraint.
arms.P: Fixed twelve-probe schedule, independent of target, observations and outputs. No selection calls.
arms.T: One provisional Time/Relation/Direction analysis, then one selection using the same legal-ID constraint as A. Only the selection ID authorizes execution.
arms.no_enumeration_scientific_arm: Latest user instruction specifies exactly P/A/T. Offline oracle is qualification/evaluation only.
arms.prediction_interface: Identical across all arms: complete twelve-probe authenticated ledger, reset observation and one query; no provisional analyses.
arms.previous_T_analysis: Only the immediately preceding analysis is supplied as explicitly unverified model hypothesis to the next analysis. All executed observations remain fully present.

contribution_metrics.controlled_contrast: Compared with at least one prior distinct probe: a one-action prefix/suffix extension, an adjacent swap, or a repeated-terminal-action extension. Count at most once per selected decision. Useful iff realized IG>1e-12 and at least one matched comparison has different final sensor observations.
contribution_metrics.costs: Report executed probes, actuator actions, generated/prompt tokens, model calls and wall time separately. Probe-efficiency does not imply compute-efficiency.
contribution_metrics.direction_control: Expected mutual information between the selected observation trace and each frozen planner candidate attaining the known target, averaged over the eight candidates. Also report newly resolved target-attainment propositions and realized target-uncertainty change, including negative changes.
contribution_metrics.direction_primary: Reduction of evaluator uncertainty about the fixed sealed short/long predictions; never fed back to model.
contribution_metrics.efficiency_area: Per-world sum over t=1..12 of log2(H_t)/log2(H_0), divided by12. Smaller is better; every step collected without extra inference.
contribution_metrics.grounded_falsification_T: Both stated A/B alternatives parse to the same valid sensor and in-probe step, opposite bits, both possible under H before execution. Count favored-expectation falsification only if actual outcome matches B. Never infer truth of the surrounding causal prose. No comparable A/P prose is collected; do not claim an intent comparison.
contribution_metrics.ranks: Midrank over79; ties tolerance1e-12. Top quartile requires positive IG and midrank<=79/4. All-zero ties do not qualify.
contribution_metrics.relation_contrast: One-action prefix/suffix extension; record nonzero final-observation delta separately. This is a scoped experimental contrast, not proof of a context-free causal rule.
contribution_metrics.relations_added: Increase in number of contextual-endpoint and reversed-order delta cards whose values agree across H. Finite candidate-family entailment only; no global independence claim.
contribution_metrics.repetition: Exact same reset sequence; after a valid first observation it has mathematically zero IG. No anti-repeat policy is encoded.
contribution_metrics.temporal_constraints_added: Increase in number of actuator/sensor onset cards whose value agrees across all consistent roots. Onset is first change from reset on AAA within three steps; 0 means none in this tested horizon, not no possible delayed effect.
contribution_metrics.time_contrast: Reversal/adjacent-order swap or repeated-terminal-action extension with a prior probe; no assertion that elapsed time alone has been isolated.

control.budget: Four reset control probes, each three actions; report both units.
control.planner_candidates: Eight seeded legal three-action probes. Shared across arms and frozen before inference.
control.predictions: Eight A0 predictions per arm from that arm frozen discovery ledger and known target. Same prediction prompt for all.
control.selection: Predicted final-state Hamming distance to target; malformed prediction distance5; ties frozen candidate order. Execute top four from reset, stop at actual target. No oracle or replanning.
control.target_generation: Uniform random four-bit target drawn independently of hidden program and candidate order; offline reject whole candidate if target equals reset or not attained by exactly one of eight seeded candidate probes. Target reveals no correct candidate index or program.
control.target_revelation: Identical frozen target provided to P/A/T public arm context BEFORE discovery, as explicitly authorized by user. Passive schedule remains independent.

decoder.decoding: Greedy; same model, adapter, tokenizer/template, context and constraint for A and T.
decoder.mechanism: Dynamic token trie over exact JSON {"probe_id":"Pnnn"} plus EOS for presented legal IDs. HF prefix_allowed_tokens_fn masks every other token to negative infinity.
decoder.prediction_format: Same product-token grammar across P/A/T enforces exact JSON, sensor names, trace length and integer bit domain. Only model logits choose bits. This is a prospectively qualified technical change after a synthetic-only length failure.
decoder.runtime_malfunction: If finite-language invariant fails, stop as technical failure; never execute an invalid action.
decoder.validation: Assert exact complete legal token path including EOS and every step zero illegal-token support. Audit raw constrained branch probabilities.

hypotheses.class: Ordered product of four roots from the new full-behavior-deduplicated finite catalogue. Uniform independent root prior conditioned on public reset. Sampling strata and qualification do not further restrict H.
hypotheses.evaluator: Exact root-factorized filtering, joint trace partition counts, entropy, expected/worst posterior counts. No evaluator outputs in model prompts.
hypotheses.root_deduplication: Exact reachable finite-state Mealy equivalence preserving actuator labels, not equality on short traces.
hypotheses.sampling: One root each from interaction, delay, latch and repetition groups, then randomly permute sensor slots.

over_active_gate.definition: The T-A prediction, information, efficiency, controlled-contrast, schema and integrity components of the primary gate, using its Holm-adjusted prediction p. Report even if T-P fails.
over_active_gate.name: TRIANGULATION_OVER_ACTIVE_SUPPORTED

prohibitions: automatic follow-up training or RSI study

qualification.all_prior_worlds_excluded: All 3440 prior causal worlds, all 160 frozen active-causal worlds including unexecuted ones, and all engineering worlds; graph isomorphism under actuator/sensor renaming.
qualification.long_queries: Aperiodic for every period 1,2,3; at least one change after step3 relative to step3.
qualification.marginal: Per-sensor/step majority over observed traces reaching that step; tie0; fallback reset. For query steps beyond3 hold step3 estimate. Same query-independent predictor within an arm/world.
qualification.oracle_catalogue: Same 79 legal choices; greedy expected IG, ties original sequence catalogue order. Never A/T policy.
qualification.oracle_must_identify: All five short and all three long reserved query traces.
qualification.short_queries: All five internally nonconstant and mutually distinct complete traces.

raw_protocol.immutable: No scientific response or score may change world/query sets, model/adapter, settings, gates, prompts, budget or ID mappings.
order: hash and commit authenticated raw evidence
score correctness and all contribution metrics
raw_protocol.technical_interruption: Never repeat a durably completed response. A request with a durable intent but no durable complete response may be resumed with identical semantic input, frozen settings and fresh inference state, recording an interruption and attempt number; at most three attempts per logical request. No experiment is executed until one complete response is durable. This is technical recovery only, never triggered by response quality.

reservation.catalogue: All 84 length-1/2/3 sequences; reserve five length-3 queries first; give IDs only to remaining 79.
reservation.legal_ID_mapping: Shuffle all 79 legal sequences using prospective world PRNG; enumerate stable opaque P000...P078. IDs do not encode shortest-first or information ranking.
reservation.long_queries: One independently seeded sequence of each length 4,5,6 per world, fixed before inference. Never legal discovery actions.
reservation.procedure: Seeded uniform draw within each equality pattern excluding Passive schedule. Reject whole world/query candidate on offline qualification failure. No replacement after model behavior.
reservation.why_length3: A shorter reserved query would be exposed by an allowed longer prefix.

tests.control: Two-sided exact paired McNemar, Holm correction across T-P/T-A at alpha=.05.
tests.information: One-sided exact paired sign test on cumulative-bit differences; abs(delta)<=1e-12 ties dropped; all ties p=1.
tests.multiplicity: Each named gate is separately reported; primary T contrasts use Holm. Required conjunctions are intersection-union claims, not opportunities to select a favorable component.
tests.prediction: One-sided exact paired sign-flip test of per-machine correct-query-count differences; whole machines remain intact. Dynamic programming computes exact tail; zero differences retained as neutral. Holm correction for the T-P/T-A pair at alpha=.01. Endpoint McNemar is descriptive only.
